reasons: Content License forbids distributing Content on a Standalone basis; unmodified galleries risk breach
API only allows temporary display of returned URLs; must download first
terms say Pixabay may cancel or change the licences at sole discretion

counter_evidence.quote: You cannot sell or distribute the Content (either in digital or physical form) on a Standalone basis.
permanent hotlinking of images (using Pixabay URLs in your app) is not allowed.

note: Terms (updated 20 Oct 2026) define Standalone as content in substantially the same form (resizing, cropping, filters stay Standalone). A programmatic site that shows Pixabay images unaltered as a gallery/search result is arguably Standalone distribution; using them as illustrations inside new creative works is fine. Other prohibited uses: political context, dating, adult-related, trademarks/logos for commercial goods, recognisable people. Also: API images need full-API approval for originals; 24h cache of API responses; no mass downloads. Commercial use itself is fine, no attribution needed for the images (API asks for a plain 'source' credit when showing search results). Suggest yellow-ish treatment: ambiguous display depending on use.
